title: Distribute sealed climate data through main2 with clone setup

acceptance.text: Include one unchanged verified v1.0.0 archive and metadata in a versioned Git path, with no raw/cache duplication and recorded size/hash limits.
acceptance.evidence: Copied the unchanged 88,023,118-byte archive to data/climate/packages/v1.0.0 with its original SHA-256 4a0ba04c9c8beaa0a908e0b4d61cc23c6b90f87ad927bbe229405860eda6117b, original manifest and checksum. One compressed archive is included; raw and expanded caches remain ignored. Official GitHub limits permit this file below 100 MiB with a warning above 50 MiB.

acceptance.text: Provide safe idempotent offline setup after cloning and test it without pre-existing ignored caches; preserve sealed source/data and scientific limitations.
acceptance.evidence: One-command installer passed fresh local Git-clone setup at /private/tmp/soil-climate-repo-check.hQFGV1/repo with no pre-existing ignored caches. It verified/extracted all 2,618 payload files and validated 100 raw requests, registry and geometry roles with networking blocked. Repeated --verify-only passed; all 113 Python tests passed after preserving the newer teammate commit.

acceptance.text: Commit and push the authorized data/setup/docs to main2, verify a fresh GitHub clone and record actual delivery status without claiming application integration.
acceptance.evidence: Implementation committed as ebbada9 and remote teammate work preserved in merge 38b97a4. Fresh local Git-clone setup passed; GitHub upload and fresh remote-clone checks were not run because push was rejected before execution.
blockers: Automatic approval review rejected git push origin main2: exact archive payload/destination authorization and permission to redistribute the included BAMIS mapping need explicit user confirmation.
